candidates.title: The CT spirometer may be measuring remodeled airway walls
candidates.question: Is the Park et al. chest-CT pulmonary-function model using Pi10, the standardized airway-wall thickness, when it predicts FEV1?

rung.move_up: Validated selective erasure reaches rung 1; reconstruction/site replication gates rung 2; Pi10 supplies the named rung-3 vocabulary.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: The pulmonary-function model is using standardized airway-wall thickness (Pi10) as an image cue for airflow obstruction.

X_measurement.X: Pi10: the square root of airway wall area predicted for an airway with internal perimeter 10 mm.
X_measurement.how: Segment the airway tree, measure lumen and outer wall cross-sections orthogonal to branch centerlines, regress square-root wall area on internal perimeter, and evaluate at 10 mm. Automated airway/vessel morphometry was validated by Nardelli et al. (Med Image Anal 2020, arXiv:2002.05702).
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes; it is a formula over automated airway masks and CT voxels, without reader labels.

candidates.suspected_signal: Chronic airway inflammation and remodeling thicken bronchial walls and narrow conducting airways, raising resistance and lowering FEV1.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Sharp kernels, slice thickness, partial volume, and inspiration level alter apparent wall thickness.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: The published Park pulmonary-function model (or a faithfully obtainable checkpoint) can be run on scans on which a Pi10 direction can be selectively removed without also erasing emphysema extent or lung volume.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Inspected primary methods/abstract: Park et al., Radiology 2023, DOI 10.1148/radiol.221488, PMID 36786699, trained on 16,148 same-day LDCT/spirometry examinations and reported test CCC 0.91 for FEV1. No public checkpoint or validated selective Pi10 erasure was established.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The nearby verified fact is that CT predicts FEV1 and Pi10 is computable. I am still assuming the exact model is obtainable and that its Pi10 representation is separable from emphysema and lung size; that conjunction is the real keystone.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung yet; rung 1 requires a causal score change after validated selective erasure, rung 2 requires acquisition robustness, and rung 3 follows only if both hold.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It resembles idea-007 because respiratory state can change both airway caliber and framing. It differs by targeting fixed airway-wall remodeling and explicitly matching lung volume/inspiration; nevertheless preprocessing comparability remains a Stage-0 gate. Annotation provenance does not apply because Pi10 is voxel-computed.

closest_prior_work.citation: Park et al., Deep Learning-based Approach to Predict Pulmonary Function at Chest CT
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: The CNN predicted FEV1 and FVC from LDCT.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not establish that Pi10 was used.

closest_prior_work.citation: Nardelli et al., Generative-based Airway and Vessel Morphology Quantification
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Automated cross-sectional airway wall and lumen measurements were related to Pi10 and FEV1%.
closest_prior_work.delta: It measured airways rather than decoding a pulmonary-function network.

existing_assets: Published pulmonary-function architecture and cohort description
Automated airway-tree and cross-sectional morphometry methods
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: First reproduce the frozen model. Fit a Pi10 probe on training data only, erase its validation-selected representation direction, and test paired FEV1-output change on an untouched test set while preserving total lung volume, emphysema percentage, airway count, and reconstruction strata. A matched random-direction erasure is the sham.
candidates.use_vs_association: A score-Pi10 correlation is exploratory; use requires a selective representation erasure that changes predicted FEV1 more than matched random erasures while leaving emphysema and volume decoding intact.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Stratify and replicate; not ruled out at scout stage.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Match lung volume and supine position.
standing_confounds_addressed.habitus: Adjust thoracic size and BMI where available.
standing_confounds_addressed.prevalence_referral: Temporal external test helps but screening spectrum remains.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage: Same-day spirometry is not visible in the image/report; primary test is self-comparison.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The erased direction is emphysema extent.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Require retained emphysema-percentage decoding and compare an emphysema-direction erasure.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The model uses lung size/inspiration rather than wall thickness.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Match lung volume and require preserved lung-volume decoding.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Kernel-dependent edge sharpness creates Pi10.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Kernel-stratified replication and within-kernel calibration; not fully excluded without multi-site data.

anticipated_negative.reason: A null erasure can reflect nonlinear or distributed encoding; it is decisive only after a preregistered probe-recovery floor.

candidates.remaining_legwork: 2 days to locate/verify checkpoint availability; 1 week for airway measurement and probe reliability; first go/no-go in 10 days.

clarity.why: One model output and one standardized measurement.

identifiability.why: Selective erasure and retained-rival decoding address the main alternatives, but distributed encoding remains.

medical_relevance.why: Would connect a black-box CT spirometer to airway remodeling.

interest.why: Separates airway disease from the obvious lung-volume explanation.

prior_legwork.why: Model study, endpoint, and airway measurement exist.

feasibility.why: Capped because the runnable checkpoint/edit keystone is uninspected.

data_readiness.why: The original cohort and checkpoint are not confirmed public.

evaluation_readiness.why: FEV1, Pi10, and retained-decoding controls are defined.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; bounded search found no causal Pi10 audit.

regret.why: A modest audit could explain a high-performing physiological predictor.

unverified_claims: The Park checkpoint is obtainable
Pi10 can be selectively erased
No prior causal Pi10 audit exists

candidates.title: The kidney model may be reading fat packed into the renal sinus
candidates.question: Is Merlin using renal sinus fat fraction as a compressive metabolic cue when it predicts chronic kidney disease?

rung.move_up: A renal-sinus-only substitution reaches rung 1; vendor/phase/site controls gate rung 2; renal sinus fat is already named for rung 3.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: Merlin is using renal sinus fat fraction as an image cue for chronic kidney disease.

X_measurement.X: Renal sinus fat volume divided by kidney volume.
X_measurement.how: Segment kidneys and renal sinus; classify fat voxels by calibrated CT attenuation (typically -190 to -30 HU), sum voxel volume, and normalize by kidney volume. Fujioka et al. used CT renal sinus fat volume in CKD (Clin Exp Nephrol 2023, DOI 10.1007/s10157-023-02350-0; PMID 37095344).
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes; segmentation plus an HU threshold is independently executable on a new CT.

candidates.suspected_signal: Ectopic fat within the nonexpandable renal sinus may compress low-pressure veins and lymphatics and accompanies obesity, hypertension, and renal impairment.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Contrast phase changes soft-tissue boundaries; thick slices and partial volume alter small sinus-fat pockets; visceral adiposity is the biological rival.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: An obtainable Merlin CKD output and compatible abdominal CTs permit renal-sinus fat to be changed while preserving kidney parenchyma, collecting system, total visceral fat, and input distribution.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Inspected primary artifacts: Blankemeier et al., Nature 2026, DOI 10.1038/s41586-026-10181-8, PMID 41781626, reports 692 phenotypes and six 5-year chronic diseases; Fujioka et al. directly measured renal sinus fat in 56 CKD patients. The exact released CKD head and edit validity were not inspected.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The easy facts are that Merlin predicts chronic disease and renal sinus fat is measurable. I am still assuming CKD is an exposed score and that a sinus-only tissue-for-tissue substitution can preserve surrounding anatomy and distribution; this is load-bearing.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. A validated sinus-only substitution could reach rung 1; external protocol replication is required for rung 2 and hence the rung-3 sentence.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It resembles scout-006-c03 (Merlin diabetes/liver fat) but uses a different disease, organ compartment, and proposed compressive mechanism. It avoids association-only inference through sinus-only substitution and visceral-fat-matched controls. No annotation provenance is required.

closest_prior_work.citation: Blankemeier et al., Merlin
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Merlin was evaluated over 752 tasks including chronic-disease prediction.
closest_prior_work.delta: The paper did not identify renal sinus fat as a CKD cue.

closest_prior_work.citation: Fujioka et al., Prognostic impact of renal sinus fat accumulation in CKD
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Normalized renal sinus fat was associated with hypertension and future eGFR decline in a small biopsy cohort.
closest_prior_work.delta: It studied patient biology, not model use.

candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: On a frozen cohort, replace only renal-sinus fat voxels with anatomically registered, attenuation-matched sinus tissue from low-fat donors while holding kidney, perirenal fat, and total visceral fat fixed; compare paired CKD-score changes with equal-volume perirenal-fat and random-sinus shams.
candidates.use_vs_association: Observed CKD score versus sinus fat is exploratory. The use claim requires a dose-ordered paired response to sinus-only substitutions beyond perirenal and visceral-fat shams.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Within-scan edits remove case-level factors; replicate by phase/vendor/site.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Within-scan comparison largely rules it out.
standing_confounds_addressed.habitus: Hold total visceral and perirenal fat fixed; residual anatomy remains.
standing_confounds_addressed.prevalence_referral: Does not affect paired score change but limits generalization.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage: No reports or CKD labels enter the primary paired readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The model uses total visceral adiposity.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Keep total fat constant and use equal-volume perirenal-fat controls.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The edit disrupts renal-hilum anatomy.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Registration, topology checks, discriminator equivalence, and random-sinus sham; remains the chief risk.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Contrast phase, not fat, drives the score.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Within-scan edit plus phase-stratified replication.

anticipated_negative.reason: A null may mean failed realistic substitution; after edit-detectability and positive-control gates it becomes a meaningful rejection of appreciable use.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Fat packing in a constrained compartment from renal biomechanics.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: Sinus-fat fraction normalized to kidney volume, not generic visceral fat.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would measure general obesity; the packing mechanism dictates the confined renal-sinus compartment and perirenal-fat control.

candidates.remaining_legwork: 1 day to inspect Merlin outputs; 3-5 days to test renal-sinus segmentation; about 2 weeks to validate substitutions.

clarity.why: Specific compartment, ratio, output, and intervention.

identifiability.why: Within-scan compartment substitution separates general adiposity, but edit realism is uncertain.

medical_relevance.why: Could expose an actionable ectopic-fat substrate of CKD prediction.

interest.why: A kidney model reading fat inside the hilum is unexpected yet mechanistic.

prior_legwork.why: Model and measurement exist; sinus segmentation/editing need work.

feasibility.why: Capped; output and edit keystone uninspected.

data_readiness.why: Merlin assets are released, compatible scoring cohort still needs audit.

evaluation_readiness.why: X is defined but substitution validity metrics are custom.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; no direct decoding study found in bounded search.

regret.why: The compartment is routinely present and cheap to quantify.

unverified_claims: Merlin exposes a CKD score
A renal-sinus substitution can be in-distribution
The effect is separable from total adiposity

candidates.title: The brain-tumor prognosticator may be weighing the chewing muscle
candidates.question: Is a whole-head glioblastoma survival model using temporalis muscle thickness as a frailty cue rather than only tumor biology?

rung.move_up: Tumor-stable within-patient score tracking plus selective temporalis substitution reaches rung 1; acquisition/treatment controls gate rung 2; temporalis thickness provides rung 3.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: The glioblastoma survival model is using temporalis muscle thickness as an image marker of systemic frailty.

X_measurement.X: Bilateral temporalis muscle cross-sectional area and thickness on axial T1 MRI, normalized to cranial size.
X_measurement.how: Automatically segment left and right temporalis at standardized orbital/temporal levels and compute area and maximum orthogonal thickness. A multi-dataset deep-learning implementation and prognostic validation were reported by Surov et al./Furtner-related work (Neurooncol Adv 2022, PMCID PMC8770629).
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes; an automated segmentation produces continuous geometry without a radiologist rating.

candidates.suspected_signal: Cancer cachexia, corticosteroid exposure, inactivity, and frailty reduce craniofacial skeletal muscle; whole-head models can see this extracranial tissue even when the tumor is stable.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Head field-of-view cropping, coil bias, slice angulation, edema, and postsurgical change can alter apparent thickness or model framing.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: A runnable whole-head survival model retains extracranial temporalis in its exact input tensor, and enough longitudinal MRIs have stable tumor burden but measurable temporalis change to separate frailty from tumor progression.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Primary full text inspected: PMCID PMC8770629 reports automated temporalis segmentation across four datasets; GRASP, PMID 38285679, reports whole-brain post-radiotherapy MRI survival prediction. The exact GRASP preprocessing, checkpoint availability, and count of tumor-stable longitudinal pairs retaining temporalis were not established.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The adjacent facts are that temporalis predicts prognosis and an MRI model predicts survival. I am still assuming the survival model actually sees extracranial muscle and an obtainable longitudinal subset decorrelates muscle loss from tumor change; that is the real keystone.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung; longitudinal association alone is insufficient. Rung 1 needs convergent within-subject and selective-substitution evidence.
candidates.dies_like_prior: No annotation-provenance failure applies because muscle geometry and tumor volume are automated. It risks the same use-versus-association error seen across early cycles, so longitudinal correlation is explicitly exploratory and regional substitution is required for the use claim.

closest_prior_work.citation: Deep learning-based quantification of temporalis muscle has prognostic value in glioblastoma
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Automated temporalis quantification generalized across four datasets and was prognostic.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not test reliance by a whole-image survival model.

closest_prior_work.citation: GRASP study
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: A whole-brain post-radiotherapy MRI model predicted glioblastoma survival.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not isolate extracranial muscle as a used signal.

existing_assets: Public brain-tumor MRI collections with serial imaging
Automated tumor and temporalis segmentation methods
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Freeze a survival model and identify serial scans with stable automated enhancing/nonenhancing tumor volume. Test whether score change tracks temporalis change, then substitute only extracranial temporalis patches between same-sequence scans with matched coil-field intensity. Require dose response, unchanged tumor embeddings, and null scalp/fat shams.
candidates.use_vs_association: The within-subject relationship is only triangulation; the use claim requires temporalis-only substitution to move survival score while brain/tumor tensors and tumor embeddings remain fixed.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Same-sequence within-patient pairs and intensity-matched substitutions reduce them; coil/site replication remains.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: Rigid cranial registration and standardized planes.
standing_confounds_addressed.habitus: Within-subject design controls baseline habitus, not systemic treatment changes.
standing_confounds_addressed.prevalence_referral: Paired estimand is robust but GBM treatment cohort limits scope.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage: No report text or survival label is used in the paired substitution readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Tumor progression causes both score and wasting.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Prespecified stable-tumor pairs plus tumor-fixed substitution.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Steroid treatment changes both muscle and brain edema.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Medication adjustment where available; substitution holds brain fixed but biological interpretation remains limited.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The model responds to extracranial edit seams.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Scalp/fat and left-right sham substitutions with distribution checks.

anticipated_negative.reason: A null can reflect a tumor-cropped model or insufficient muscle change; becomes decisive only after confirmed visibility and positive-control sensitivity.

candidates.remaining_legwork: 2-3 days to inspect model input/preprocessing; 1 week for longitudinal pair counts; 2 weeks to first intervention result.

clarity.why: Named muscle metric and explicit whole-head outcome.

identifiability.why: Tumor-fixed regional substitution directly separates muscle from tumor burden, subject to seam validity.

medical_relevance.why: Would reveal frailty contamination or useful holistic prognostication.

interest.why: A brain-tumor model using chewing muscle is surprising and clinically legible.

prior_legwork.why: Both component literatures exist, but runnable convergence is unclear.

feasibility.why: Capped; model visibility and longitudinal subset uninspected.

data_readiness.why: Serial survival-linked MRI access and checkpoint need confirmation.

evaluation_readiness.why: Muscle/tumor metrics exist; edit validation is custom.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; bounded search found association studies but no use audit.

regret.why: Extracranial tissue is easy to overlook and may dominate prognosis.

unverified_claims: An obtainable survival model retains temporalis
Enough tumor-stable serial pairs exist
Temporalis-only substitution can pass distribution checks

candidates.title: The risk model may be reading the breast's lines of force
candidates.question: Is Mirai using radial alignment of fibroglandular strands toward the nipple as a stromal-tension cue for future breast cancer?

rung.move_up: Orientation-selective perturbation reaches rung 1; vendor/compression replication gates rung 2; radial stromal alignment is the proposed rung-3 term.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: Mirai is using radial alignment of fibroglandular strands toward the nipple as an image marker of breast-cancer risk.

X_measurement.X: Radial alignment index: mean cosine-of-double-angle agreement between local ridge orientation and the pixel-to-nipple radial vector, within fibroglandular tissue.
X_measurement.how: Segment breast and nipple, estimate ridge orientation using a multiscale Hessian/structure tensor, and average cos(2(delta angle)) weighted by ridge strength; compare with tangential and shuffled orientation controls.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes; it is a deterministic image measurement requiring no semantic labels.

candidates.suspected_signal: Collagen and Cooper-ligament organization transmit mechanical tension through glandular tissue; persistent radial alignment could encode involution, stromal remodeling, or occult field effects before a mass is visible.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Compression direction, pectoral edge, detector processing, view geometry, and nipple localization can manufacture radial line structure.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: Radial alignment is reproducible across CC/MLO views and serial exams after controlling compression and detector processing, and can be perturbed without changing density, low-frequency anatomy, or creating line artifacts.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Official Mirai repository inspected: https://github.com/reginabarzilaygroup/Mirai states released research code/model and external C-indices 0.76-0.81. Yala et al., J Clin Oncol 2022, 'Towards Robust Mammography-Based Models for Breast Cancer Risk' is the primary model report. No primary source establishing this radial-alignment keystone was found.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The easy facts are that Mirai runs and mammographic texture predicts risk. I am still assuming radial orientation is a stable biological quantity rather than compression geometry and that an orientation-only edit is valid; that is the load-bearing keystone.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. Because this is Mode C, a failed reproducibility gate is itself an early kill; only a validated orientation perturbation reaches rung 1.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It resembles idea-015 only by using Mirai; it does not revive BAC or vascular age and uses a different tensor-native measurement and mechanism. It avoids annotation provenance because alignment is computed, but could die by identifiability if compression cannot be separated from biology.

closest_prior_work.citation: Yala et al., Towards Robust Mammography-Based Models for Breast Cancer Risk
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Mirai predicts 1-5-year risk and is released for research.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not name radial fibroglandular alignment.

closest_prior_work.citation: Using Explainable AI to Characterize Features in Mirai
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Feature-centric analysis linked Mirai features to calcifications, masses, and breast anatomy.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not causally test the defined radial-alignment index.

closest_prior_work.citation: Automated percent density, texture variation, and breast cancer risk
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Automated texture variation contributed risk information beyond density.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not measure radial orientation or model reliance.

existing_assets: Public mammograms sufficient for label-free score perturbation
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: On frozen CC/MLO exams, phase-randomize only the high-frequency oriented fibroglandular component within local patches to reduce radial alignment while preserving power spectrum, density, breast outline, and nipple location. Compare Mirai risk change against tangentialized, orientation-shuffled, and fat-region shams; require consistent effects across both views and vendors.
candidates.use_vs_association: Risk-alignment correlation is not evidence of use. The claim requires dose-ordered Mirai score response to alignment-selective perturbation with density and spatial spectrum held fixed.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Within-image perturbation holds them fixed; cross-vendor replication tests generality.
standing_confounds_addressed.positioning: CC/MLO concordance and nipple-relative coordinates; compression remains dangerous.
standing_confounds_addressed.habitus: Breast area and density held fixed.
standing_confounds_addressed.prevalence_referral: No labels needed for primary response; does not establish clinical causality.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage: No reports or risk labels enter perturbation readout.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Mirai reacts to generic high-frequency texture damage.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Power-spectrum-matched tangential and shuffled controls.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Radial alignment is compression geometry, not stroma.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Cross-view/serial reproducibility and compression metadata where available; may remain fatal.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The nipple detector leaks view position into X.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Perturb nipple localization and repeat with independently defined breast centroid.

anticipated_negative.reason: If a powered, spectrum-preserving dose series changes X substantially but leaves Mirai risk within a prespecified equivalence margin, it directly weakens use of this X.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Principal stress-line alignment from soft-tissue mechanics and fiber-composite analysis.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: A nipple-relative orientation order parameter, not generic texture entropy.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would revert to undirected texture variation; the mechanics analogy uniquely dictates orientation, radial coordinates, and tangential controls.

candidates.remaining_legwork: 3 days for repeatability screen; 1 week for perturbation validation; first decisive model result in about 2 weeks.

clarity.why: A formula, coordinate system, and perturbation are explicit.

identifiability.why: Spectrum-matched controls isolate orientation, but compression may be inseparable.

medical_relevance.why: Could reveal a preclinical stromal risk substrate, though biological interpretation is speculative.

interest.why: A model reading tissue lines of force would be broadly compelling.

prior_legwork.why: Model and texture tools exist; biological bridge is thin.

data_readiness.why: Primary readout needs only runnable Mirai and mammograms.

evaluation_readiness.why: Alignment metric is defined but not standardized clinically.

negative_result_value.why: A validated equivalence result is decisive for this X.

regret.why: The experiment is inexpensive relative to the mechanism's interest.

unverified_claims: Radial alignment is biologically stable
Orientation-only perturbations are in-distribution
No prior study tested this exact X

candidates.title: The lung-cancer model may be reading the marrow as a smoking dosimeter
candidates.question: Is Sybil using vertebral marrow attenuation heterogeneity as an image signature of smoking-related marrow remodeling?

rung.move_up: Vertebra-only substitution reaches rung 1; reconstruction/site/smoking-stratum controls gate rung 2; marrow attenuation heterogeneity supplies rung 3.

candidates.deliverable_sentence: Sybil is using vertebral marrow attenuation heterogeneity as an image marker of smoking-related systemic remodeling.

X_measurement.X: Within-vertebral trabecular marrow HU distribution: median, interquartile range, and spatial variogram after excluding cortex, focal lesions, and vessels.
X_measurement.how: Automatically segment T1-T12 vertebrae, erode cortex, exclude fracture/focal-lesion outliers, then compute calibrated HU histogram dispersion and a 3D semivariogram normalized by reconstruction noise.
X_measurement.could_compute_today_without_asking_anyon: Yes; the measurement is fully specified over automated vertebral masks and CT voxels.

candidates.suspected_signal: Smoking, aging, inflammation, and altered hematopoiesis change marrow cellularity and fat conversion; the vertebral body could therefore carry a distributed exposure signature visible on LDCT.
candidates.specific_artifact_confused_with_signal: Kernel, dose, photon noise, beam hardening, vertebral level, osteoporosis, anemia, and occult metastasis all alter marrow HU heterogeneity.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: After noise normalization and vertebral-level matching, marrow heterogeneity remains a reproducible patient property that can be substituted between LDCTs without changing bone cortex, reconstruction texture, or model input distribution.
candidates.keystone_evidence: Primary Sybil full text inspected: Mikhael et al., J Clin Oncol 2023, DOI 10.1200/JCO.22.01345, PMCID PMC10419602, used whole-volume LDCT and no clinical variables, validated on 6,282 NLST, 8,821 MGH, and 12,280 CGMH scans. No primary evidence established the marrow-heterogeneity keystone or smoking mechanism.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The verified nearby fact is that Sybil sees the whole CT and generalizes across cohorts. I am still assuming marrow texture exceeds reconstruction noise and that tissue substitution can isolate marrow from bone density and age; that is the real keystone.
candidates.rung_reached: No rung. Mode C Stage 0 first tests repeatability; rung 1 needs vertebra-only causal response, and the systemic-remodeling gloss waits for rung 2.
candidates.dies_like_prior: It resembles idea-011 in proposing a skeletal aging/exposure clock. It differs by using native within-marrow tissue substitution rather than deletion of mineralized cartilage, with cortex-preserving, level-matched donor tissue and explicit noise controls. It still dies if edit validity cannot be demonstrated. Annotation provenance does not apply.

closest_prior_work.citation: Mikhael et al., Sybil
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: Sybil predicts 1-6-year lung cancer risk from the entire LDCT without clinical variables.
closest_prior_work.delta: It did not test vertebral marrow as a cue.

closest_prior_work.citation: Auditing Sybil: Generative Interventional Attributions
closest_prior_work.verified_fact: A 2026 preprint reports object-specific generative interventions and artifacts/radial bias.
closest_prior_work.delta: The bounded search did not find a vertebral-marrow heterogeneity intervention; novelty remains unverified.

existing_assets: TCIA/NLST application pathway and other LDCT cohorts
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: First estimate test-retest/reconstruction repeatability of marrow dispersion on same-acquisition pairs. If it passes, transplant eroded trabecular marrow texture between level-, sex-, age-, BMD-, and noise-matched vertebrae while leaving cortex and surrounding anatomy fixed. Test paired Sybil risk response against phase-scrambled same-HU, paraspinal-muscle, and cortical-bone shams.
candidates.use_vs_association: Smoking/marrow/risk correlations are exploratory only. Use requires a dose-ordered Sybil response to marrow-only substitution beyond noise- and HU-matched shams.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Same-acquisition repeatability gate and within-image edits; cross-site replication remains required.
standing_confounds_addressed.habitus: Match paraspinal muscle and body size; not fully ruled out.
standing_confounds_addressed.prevalence_referral: Paired response is label-free, but screening-cohort spectrum limits interpretation.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage: No reports or outcomes enter primary substitution.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Sybil uses osteoporosis/age rather than marrow remodeling.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Match BMD, cortex, age and vertebral level; separately substitute mean HU versus spatial heterogeneity.

alternative_explanations.alternative: It responds to reconstruction noise.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Same-acquisition repeatability, local noise normalization, and noise-matched shams.

alternative_explanations.alternative: Occult metastasis or focal lesion drives the signal.
alternative_explanations.resolution: Automated focal-outlier exclusion and require diffuse multi-level consistency.

anticipated_negative.reason: If repeatability and substitution-sensitivity controls pass yet large marrow changes keep Sybil risk within an equivalence margin, appreciable use of this X is weakened.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: A dosimeter/readout of cumulative exposure, borrowed from hematopoietic ecology and materials heterogeneity.
cross_domain.measurement_implied: Diffuse level-normalized marrow HU dispersion and spatial correlation, not mean bone density.
cross_domain.if_analogy_dropped: The experiment would test generic vertebral attenuation; the dosimeter idea dictates diffuse multilevel consistency, texture heterogeneity, and smoking-stratified validation.

candidates.remaining_legwork: 3-5 days for repeatability on reconstruction pairs; 1 week for marrow masks/noise normalization; 2-3 weeks to first substitution result.

clarity.why: X and intervention are explicit, while the exact biological substrate remains composite.

identifiability.why: Matching and component-wise substitution address age/BMD/noise, but marrow biology remains mixed.

medical_relevance.why: Would reveal a systemic exposure cue behind cancer risk prediction.

interest.why: A lung-risk model reading vertebral marrow would be genuinely surprising.

candidates.critical_confound: The active edit may create an unnatural lung-diaphragm boundary or alter global lung shape/framing, so a positive result could reflect sensitivity to synthetic geometry rather than native use of inspiratory depth.

alternative_explanations.alternative: CT-CLIP responds to interpolation or boundary seams.
alternative_explanations.control: Equal-energy lateral-pleural and phase-scrambled boundary shams, multiple interpolation kernels, and a blinded active-versus-sham edit discriminator.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The edit changes lung volume or crop occupancy rather than diaphragm height.
alternative_explanations.control: Match final-tensor framing exactly and either preserve total lung volume with local compensation or estimate diaphragm-height and lung-volume effects separately in a factorial edit.

alternative_explanations.alternative: The output is driven by actual calcium or reconstruction noise.
alternative_explanations.control: Copy all hyperattenuating and aortic voxels bit-for-bit, stratify by automated calcium burden and reconstruction metadata, and use only within-volume comparisons.

standing_confounds_addressed.scanner_vendor_protocol_reconstruction_s: Held fixed within each edited volume; stratified replication tests effect stability but does not establish broad generalization.
standing_confounds_addressed.patient_positioning: The source scan and crop are fixed; native positioning cannot explain paired changes, although the edit may resemble a positioning artifact.
standing_confounds_addressed.disease_prevalence_and_referral_pathway: Cannot cause paired output changes, but could explain why a model learned the cue and limits interpretation.
standing_confounds_addressed.label_leakage_from_report: No report or label enters the primary paired readout; report-derived training labels could still explain why the shortcut was learned.

anticipated_negative.reason: If validated edits span the natural diaphragm-height range, the model responds to a positive control, sham effects remain below threshold, and the arterial-wall-calcification output remains within a preregistered equivalence margin, appreciable use of this defined X is weakened. If edit-validity gates fail, the result is uninterpretable and is not counted as a negative.

rung.move_up: A validated plaque-preserving perturbation can reach rung 1. Replication across reconstruction/vendor strata and rejection of framing artifacts gates rung 2. Only then does the named normalized diaphragm-height sentence qualify as rung 3; the experiment does not establish why the association was learned or any mortality effect.

candidates.dies_like_prior: It most closely resembles idea-006 because a large synthetic intervention could be out of distribution, and idea-007 because respiratory state co-varies with final-tensor framing. It differs by prohibiting patient deletion, using small natural-range bidirectional boundary edits, preserving plaque voxels, and making sham/distribution gates prerequisites. It still dies the same way if those gates fail. Annotation provenance does not apply because X and the primary readout are computed without labels.

clarity.why: One released model output, one geometric X, and one directional paired test are specified.

identifiability.why: Plaque-preserving paired edits rule out patient-level confounds, but separating diaphragm height from synthetic boundary and lung-shape effects remains difficult.

medical_relevance.why: It could expose a clinically misleading respiratory-state shortcut in an arterial-calcification output, but it does not itself improve calcium quantification or outcomes.

interest.why: A calcification score driven by respiratory geometry would be surprising and consequential for interpretation.

prior_legwork.why: Model code/weights, public CT, quantitative diaphragm geometry, and automated thoracic-calcium comparators exist.

feasibility.why: Capped because counterfactual validity is not inspected; the small inference workload otherwise fits one Colab GPU session.

data_readiness.why: NLST CT images are publicly listed by TCIA and the primary test needs neither outcomes nor manual annotations.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired slope, sham ceiling, equivalence margin, X range, and voxel-preservation checks are definable before inference.

negative_result_value.why: After all sensitivity and edit-validity gates pass, equivalence directly weakens use of this X.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped by the uninspected keystone and a bounded rather than exhaustive primary-source search.

regret.why: The first gated test is small and could cheaply falsify a striking shortcut hypothesis.

unverified_claims: The current released CT-CLIP checkpoint and label mapping expose the exact arterial-wall-calcification output reproducibly.
Natural-range diaphragm-height edits can pass the declared distribution and sham gates.
The defined output uses diaphragm height in intact unedited scans.
No prior study has performed this exact causal audit.
prohibited_conclusions: Do not call the output an aortic-specific head without verifying the released label mapping.
Do not infer that CT-CLIP contains separate slice-wise and volume-wise detectors.
Do not infer mortality prediction, sign inversion, longitudinal drift, or causation from smoking or COPD.
Do not interpret a failed edit-validity gate as a negative result.
